name: Madiun Happy Cubing 2017

venue.name: Sri Ratu Plaza Madiun
venue.address: Jl. Pahlawan, Kartoharjo, Madiun, Kota Madiun, Jawa Timur 63117

information: This is the biggest official competition that held in Madiun city. The registration fee is IDR 25,000 for one event only, and IDR 50,000 for 2 or more events. For more information you can check the website or contact the organizers.
